instruction: Play the least listened to song on Spotify from the Echo Chamber Chronicles album.
notes: Single-app Spotify task. supervisor.show_profile yields the login username (email); show_account_passwords yields the spotify password; login yields the token. search_albums (no token needed) with the album title discovers the album and its song_ids; show_song is modeled once on the abstract object least-played-song, which stands for the album song with the lowest play_count (at runtime show_song is iterated over all song_ids and the min play_count song is selected). play_music with song_id sets the music player to playing that song, which is the only DB change the evaluation checks (one updated spotify.MusicPlayer record, is_playing true, current_song == least played song of the album). complete_task takes the played song as a non-API record parameter so its precondition can assert the goal condition; no answer is passed since the task asks no question.
